comment: trap.c trapname() 7136-7146: the hallucinatory role trap name takes its gender from Upolyd ? u.mfemale : flags.female (trap.c 7137). A male human Priest in debug mode polymorphs into a water nymph (polyself.c 764 saves u.mfemale=0, then the female-only form sets flags.female), quaffs a wished potion of hallucination, wishes a squeaky board, steps off and back onto it, and looks at it with '^' until the display RNG picks the role-trap entry: C names it a 'priest trap', the hero's own gender.
